memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: abdominal bloating 2-3 days/week, stool frequency variable, no alarm symptoms.
  - Plan: continue mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide 2 mg SOS; advise low‑FODMAP diet, small frequent meals.
- Obesity
  - Status: weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (male cut‑off 90 cm, female 80 cm – elevated).
  - Plan: start orlistat 120 mg with each main meal, encourage brisk walk 30 min daily, review diet.
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux
  - Status: heartburn after meals, occasional regurgitation, no dysphagia.
  - Plan: pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast, domperidone 10 mg BD before meals, antacid gel SOS; avoid late night meals, elevate head of bed.
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-07-05 (3 months).

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Allergy: aspirin – develops generalized maculopapular rash within 2 hours of ingestion; no respiratory symptoms. Avoid NSAIDs; use paracetamol for analgesia.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 12.8 g/dl (12-16), WBC 6.2 x10^9/l (4-10), Plt 210 x10^9/l (150-400).
Stool routine: ova/cyst nil, pus cells 0-1/hpf.
tTG‑IgA: <2 U/ml (<7 negative).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: bloating reduced to 1 day/week, stool consistency improved with ispaghula.
  - Plan: continue mebeverine BD, ispaghula husk OD, loperamide PRN; reinforce low‑FODMAP, avoid carbonated drinks.
- Obesity
  - Status: weight 76.5 kg, waist 90 cm (borderline).
  - Plan: continue orlistat with meals, add protein‑rich breakfast, aim 5% weight loss in 3 months.
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux
  - Status: heartburn 2 days/week, relieved by pantoprazole.
  - Plan: continue pantoprazole OD, domperidone BD, antacid SOS; avoid spicy food, coffee after 4 pm.
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-10-01.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I still feel bloated after lunch, especially after eating chapati and curry. Heartburn occurs if I skip my pantoprazole. My weight seems stuck around 76 kg.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-10-15 at 10:30 am with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) in Endocrinology OPD.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: bloating persists after high‑fiber meals; stool frequency normal.
  - Plan: add simethicone 40 mg TDS after meals, trial lactose‑free diet for 2 weeks.
- Obesity
  - Status: weight 75.8 kg, waist 89 cm (improved).
  - Plan: continue orlistat, start supervised circuit training twice weekly, review diet diary.
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux
  - Status: heartburn ≤1 day/week, well controlled.
  - Plan: continue pantoprazole OD, domperidone BD, antacid SOS; avoid lying down within 2 h of meals.
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2026-01-15.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Upper GI endoscopy: erythematous antrum, no ulcer, biopsy negative for H. pylori, no Barrett’s mucosa. Conclusion: mild gastritis, no malignant lesion.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Gastroenterology reviewed. Endoscopy shows mild gastritis, H. pylori negative. Recommend continue PPI, consider low‑dose amitriptyline for functional dyspepsia if symptoms persist. No further invasive work‑up needed.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: bloating ≤2 days/month, stool regular, no abdominal pain.
  - Plan: continue mebeverine BD, ispaghula husk OD, loperamide PRN; maintain low‑FODMAP, regular exercise.
- Obesity
  - Status: weight 73.2 kg, waist 85 cm (within female cut‑off).
  - Plan: continue orlistat, aim another 2 kg loss, add resistance training.
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux
  - Status: asymptomatic, no heartburn.
  - Plan: taper pantoprazole to 20 mg OD, continue domperidone BD, antacid SOS; monitor for rebound.
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2026-10-01.
